title: Interactive authentication RBAC and workspace isolation absent
impact: Public exposure would permit unauthenticated cross-workspace access.
root_cause: V2-11 implemented only the Agent Hub service identity.
containment: No public route or production deployment; production human writes remain disabled and the checked-in registry is empty.
remediation: V3-01-01 added external hash-only sessions, RBAC, workspace membership, denial-by-default, rate limiting and Studio login/logout.
test_plan: SEC-001 session, role, expiry/revocation, route coverage and cross-workspace tests passed locally and in disposable Docker.
rollback: Disable public route, set HUMAN_WRITE_ENABLED=false and revert the isolated auth PR.

title: Research originality and claim-linked script versioning incomplete
impact: Flow B cannot prove factual accuracy or originality.
root_cause: V2 deterministic content path creates artifacts but not a complete claim/source/originality ledger.
containment: Do not label generated scripts production-ready and do not publish.
remediation: V3-01-04: close only the V2 contract gaps needed for research, claims and immutable script evidence.
test_plan: Claim map, conflicting source, similarity and unsupported-claim rejection tests.
rollback: Hard-disable Idea-to-publish path and retain previous deterministic draft path.

title: Real ASR Vision and reframe evidence absent
impact: Flow A cannot meet accuracy thresholds using fixtures.
root_cause: Production adapters, approved credentials, budget and owned test media are not accepted.
containment: Fixtures stay development-only; production config rejects them.
remediation: V3-01-02/03: provider metadata controls then two owner-gated real-media runs.
rollback: Return selectors to contract and disable external execution.

title: Real stock AI media and ComfyUI GPU paths absent
impact: Flow B cannot create provider-backed publishable media.
root_cause: Only fixtures, contracts and an allowlisted mock bridge are available.
containment: External/paid/ComfyUI execution remains false and unknown rights block use.
test_plan: PRO-002 through PRO-005 plus asset download/decode/recovery.
rollback: Disable provider selectors and remove only the remediation adapters.

title: Production Vietnamese voice and accepted music mix absent
impact: No video can satisfy human audio acceptance.
root_cause: eSpeak is CI-only; a real TTS call/listening review and licensed music are not accepted.
containment: External audio remains disabled and eSpeak cannot be called production evidence.
remediation: V3-01-02/03/04: bounded provider test, RightsRecord and human listening.
test_plan: PRO-007, PRO-008 and QLT-002 on headphones and phone speaker.
rollback: Return AUDIO_TTS_PROVIDER to contract and external execution false.

title: Official publishing analytics and real Flow C absent
impact: Flow C cannot meet publish/read-after-write/replay/T+24h acceptance.
root_cause: Official adapters and approved targets/scopes are intentionally absent.
containment: All live gates remain false; dry-run only; no external analytics.
remediation: V3-01-05 after G-04/G-05/G-06 and platform-specific owner approval.
rollback: Global publishing kill switch; revoke target credential; no automatic takedown.

title: Production-like staging and production path not established
impact: No critical production-path axis can pass.
root_cause: No approved staging/PROD-CANARY deployment or image digest exists.
containment: Remain local/CI; no Caddy route; no deployment.
remediation: V3-01-06 prepares isolated DR/ops; G-04/G-09 precede staging deployment.
test_plan: Production-like smoke, recovery, route/auth/storage and correlation checks.
rollback: Guarded rollback to known-good image after one exists.

title: Backup restore and release rollback drills not executed
impact: GO is blocked because recoverability is unproven.
root_cause: Scripts/runbooks were syntax-tested only and no production data/image exists.
containment: Never restore over production; keep external writes disabled.
remediation: V3-01-06: isolated backup/restore/replay/rollback drill with owner-approved RPO/RTO.
rollback: Discard isolated restore target only after evidence retention; preserve source backup.

title: Observability alerting evidence retention and 48-hour soak incomplete
impact: Full GO and production incident response are blocked.
root_cause: Only request IDs, basic logs and a 24-hour readiness helper exist.
containment: No production deployment; retain deterministic CI evidence and keep writes disabled.
remediation: V3-01-06: structured correlation metrics alert tests retention and 48-hour soak tooling.
rollback: Disable new telemetry exporters/alerts and retain local logs if remediation regresses.

title: Provider safety plane implemented locally; durable multi-instance acceptance incomplete
impact: Provider testing or production use could incur uncontrolled retry/cost unless the local safety contract is made durable and production-observable.
root_cause: V3-01-02 adds the global VND budget/retry/poll/circuit/kill-switch contract, but runtime attempt, reservation and circuit state is process-local and no real provider was accepted.
containment: Do not invoke real providers before G-01/G-02/G-03; zero budgets, external gates false and global kill switch engaged.
remediation: Persist and reconcile attempt/circuit/budget state across instances, add monitoring/retention, then run owner-gated provider acceptance.
test_plan: Local RES-002/CST-001 controls pass including failed/retried calls; production durability and real-provider axes remain NOT_TESTED.
rollback: Disable provider execution and restore zero-external-call configuration.

title: Upload malware quarantine API rate limiting and SSRF suite absent
impact: Public ingress would have incomplete abuse and malicious-media protection.
root_cause: V2 validates size/MIME/hash/FFprobe but lacked the complete V3 security suite.
containment: Keep API localhost-only and URL import disabled; human requests now have a Redis-backed valid-session limit.
remediation: V3-01-01 closed auth/rate/basic malicious-input coverage; V3-01-03 must add malware scanning/quarantine, decompression-resource acceptance and production ingress controls.
test_plan: SEC-002 fake extension, oversized file, traversal, URL-import denial and argument injection passed; scanner/quarantine and production WAF remain.
rollback: Disable public upload ingress and revert the isolated security remediation.

title: Main branch protection is disabled
impact: Failed or unreviewed changes could be merged to main.
root_cause: GitHub API reports main is not protected.
containment: Keep every V3 PR draft and require explicit owner merge approval.
remediation: Owner enables required PR and Video Factory V2 CI protection settings.
test_plan: Attempt merge with missing check in a safe governance validation or inspect policy via API.
rollback: Revert branch policy only through owner governance decision.

title: Real asset rights provenance and retention not accepted
impact: No real final render is legally cleared for public use.
root_cause: Only synthetic fixtures and schema-level provenance are present.
containment: Unknown rights hard-block publishing; no public output.
remediation: V3-01-02/04: RightsRecord per asset, terms snapshot, lineage and retention.
rollback: Remove rejected asset from timeline and invalidate approval/render.

title: Real Agent Hub HTTP bridge acceptance absent
impact: Optional control-plane integration is unproven outside fixtures.
root_cause: HTTP delivery is disabled and no owner-approved destination acceptance was run.
containment: Bridge remains disabled or deterministic fixture-only; Video Factory remains independent.
remediation: Separate owner-gated signed staging request and webhook receipt/replay test.
test_plan: SEC-003 plus real staging request/receipt/restart recovery.
rollback: Disable bridge HTTP mode and external delivery; keep draft-only contract.

title: GitHub Actions runtime deprecation warning
impact: Future Actions runtime changes may become maintenance failures.
root_cause: Pinned checkout/setup actions currently receive a Node runtime compatibility warning.
containment: CI is green and remains required before merge.
remediation: Upgrade action majors in a small governance PR after checking release notes.
test_plan: Rerun all five CI jobs on main-compatible branch.

title: Human full-watch quality and historical media risks not reverified
impact: Automated CI cannot establish publish readiness or close black/silent/subtitle/voice risks.
root_cause: No owned acceptance media or designated reviewer signed exact artifact hashes.
containment: Do not claim quality accepted or publish-ready.
remediation: Run two consecutive Flow A/B RC outputs and full desktop/mobile/headphone/phone review after G-03/G-11.
test_plan: QLT-001 and QLT-002 with artifact-bound forms.
rollback: Invalidate approval after any asset/edit change and rerun full review.
